data.name: Nagendr
data.gender_notes: Nagendr is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over serpents and poisons, often considered a form of Lord Shiva. The name Nagendr carries the meaning “Lord of Serpents” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Nagendr usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of serpents and live with faith, good character and purpose.
